arguments.query: select c.full_name, c.email, sum(o.total) as revenue from public.orders o join public.customers c on c.id = o.customer_id where o.status in ('paid', 'shipped') and o.created_at >= '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z' and o.created_at < '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' group by c.id, c.full_name, c.email order by revenue desc limit 3
